SELECT sku,
       count(*) AS audits,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty,
       min(audit_ts) AS first_audit,
       max(audit_ts) AS last_audit
FROM store.shelf_audits
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT kind, count(*) AS n, min(complaint_ts) AS first_ts, max(complaint_ts) AS last_ts
FROM payments.customer_complaints
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind;

SELECT date_trunc('hour', bill_ts) AS hour, sum(qty) AS units, count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-07'
  AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-15'
GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', bill_ts)
ORDER BY hour;

WITH days AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.book_on_hand,
         a.status AS audit_status, a.audit_ts
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.date=d.date AND f.sku=d.sku
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku=d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date=d.date
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG'
)
SELECT *, round(forecast_units_per_day-units_sold,2) AS forecast_gap
FROM days
ORDER BY date;
